text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp to prepare for the fall races begins. We learn that many distinguished racers will be running in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Mejiro Palmer is undaunted by the intimidating might of the star runners and starts the summer with a bang.
